blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The national government raised more than planned in its third tranche of onshore retail dollar bonds, breaching the billion-dollar mark amid strong demand. Results from the four-day offer period showed that the government raised $1.26 billion, more than six times the original $200-million minimum target. READ: Gov’t eyes P30B RTBs sale for […]...
